_note: INVENTORY OF RUNNING ROOM IGATPURI, as counted on 21 May 2025.
Taken from 'BB RR Data.xlsx', handed over by the officer on 4 September 2026.
The workbook is the source; this file is the same figures in a form the
importer can read without a spreadsheet library on the machine that runs it.
Nothing here is edited: the row names, the column names and every count are
the workbook's own. What the importer does WITH them is decided in
db/import-inventory.js, where the reasoning can be read.
TWO THINGS THE OFFICER SAID ABOUT THIS SHEET, both of which the importer
acts on and neither of which is visible in the file itself:
'the LP mail is split in two rows just to show the ladies room data.'
So 'LP Mail' and 'LP Ladies Staff' are ONE building -- 5+1 = 6 rooms,
41+3 = 44 beds -- and the ladies row is what makes its one female room
a fact rather than a footnote.
The sheet counts five kitchens. One of them cooks; the rest serve or
reheat. So meals, the FSSAI licence and the food-safety register stay at
Igatpuri level, and the kitchen count is held as a fact about the
building, like its bathrooms.
THE DATE MATTERS. This was counted sixteen months before the contract
starts. It is the best record of what the Railway holds, and it is not a
joint accountal under General Instruction 1 -- that is signed with the
incoming contractor on handover, and these figures are what it starts from.
title: INVENTORY ITEMS OF RUNNING ROOM IGATPURI
